cmd:
set -uo pipefail; OUT_ROOT=/content/drive/MyDrive/koi_waymo2pano_colab/data/argoverse2/val; mkdir -p "$OUT_ROOT"; LOG="$OUT_ROOT/_t1_download_log.txt"; exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1; echo "[t1-dl] start $(date -u)"; df -h /content/drive 2>&1 | head -3; if ! command -v s5cmd >/dev/null; then echo '[t1-dl] installing s5cmd'; apt-get install -y s5cmd 2>&1 | tail -3 || (curl -L https://github.com/peak/s5cmd/releases/download/v2.2.2/s5cmd_2.2.2_Linux-64bit.tar.gz -o /tmp/s5cmd.tgz && tar -xzf /tmp/s5cmd.tgz -C /usr/local/bin s5cmd && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/s5cmd); fi; s5cmd version 2>&1 | head -2; PICKED_JSON=/content/Waymo2Panorama/data/av2_val_picked.json; cd /content/Waymo2Panorama && git pull --rebase 2>&1 | tail -3; if [ ! -f "$PICKED_JSON" ]; then echo '[t1-dl] ERROR: picked JSON not found at $PICKED_JSON'; exit 1; fi; UUIDS=$(python -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('$PICKED_JSON'))
for k, v in d['picks'].items():
    if v: print(v['uuid'])
"); echo '[t1-dl] downloading these UUIDs:'; echo "$UUIDS"; t0=$(date +%s); for uuid in $UUIDS; do echo "---downloading $uuid---"; td=$(date +%s); s5cmd --no-sign-request cp -c 16 "s3://argoverse/datasets/av2/sensor/val/$uuid/*" "$OUT_ROOT/$uuid/" 2>&1 | tail -10; te=$(date +%s); sz=$(du -sh "$OUT_ROOT/$uuid/" 2>&1 | head -1); echo "  $uuid: $((te-td))s, size=$sz"; df -h /content/drive 2>&1 | head -2; done; t1=$(date +%s); echo "[t1-dl] total wall: $((t1-t0))s"; echo '---verify all 4 present---'; for uuid in $UUIDS; do n_cams=$(ls "$OUT_ROOT/$uuid/sensors/cameras/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); n_lidar=$(ls "$OUT_ROOT/$uuid/sensors/lidar/" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "  $uuid: cams=$n_cams lidar_sweeps=$n_lidar"; done; echo '---write verdict---'; python -c "
import json, os
uuids='''$UUIDS'''.strip().split('\n')
root='$OUT_ROOT'
verdict = {'uuids': uuids, 'n_uuids': len(uuids), 'sizes_gb': {u: round(sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(r,f)) for r,_,fs in os.walk(os.path.join(root,u)) for f in fs)/1e9, 2) for u in uuids if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(root,u))}, 'total_wall_s': $((t1-t0))}
verdict['total_size_gb'] = round(sum(verdict['sizes_gb'].values()), 2)
print(json.dumps(verdict, indent=2))
open('$OUT_ROOT/t1_download_done.json','w').write(json.dumps(verdict, indent=2))
"; echo "[t1-dl] done $(date -u)"
